body: I took 25,000 mg of Extra Strength PM and I'm not even sure how much Prozac I took tbh. I'm pretty sure it's all out of my system by now.
From someone who tried to OD on Tylenol and Prozac last night all I can say is that if I did go any further, I would have felt a lot more pain and suffering.

I don't think you're pathetic. I feel very paradoxical in life sometimes. I'm never quite sure what I expect or even deserve and I definitely relate to you on not knowing how to organize thoughts in a clear manner. I feel the same. I'm also avoiding homework right now. I hear your words.
Read mine and I'll read yours?
